description:
Stay near Berry Hill in this stylish boutique Nashville retreat! Perfect for groups, this 3-bedroom home sleeps up to 8 with 4 beds and 2.5 baths. Enjoy a full kitchen, spacious living area, and free parking. Ideal for game days, concerts, or exploring Music City—comfort, convenience, and great vibes included.

Other things to note
**ABSOLUTELY NO LOUD GATHERINGS OR PARTIES, FINES/EVICTION/POLICE WILL BE INVOLVED IF NOT ABIDED BY**
**WE DO NOT HOST LOCALS**

DISCLAIMER:
-Additional guests outside of your confirmed guest count are not allowed on our property + go against your rental agreement.
-We have a zero tolerance policy on our property being used for ANY kind of loud gathering or party. We have cameras + security. Per your rental agreement this is grounds for eviction without question or refund + possible legal action.
-Upon confirming your booking, you are subject to our House Rules, Rental Agreement which you sign and/or enter it upon checking in, which includes this disclaimer + much more.
